description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Awoken Blazing Monk] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user, grants [Ascetic Monk Mode]/[Act As One Mode] if Edgar isn't/is alive

description.name: Awoken Blazing Monk
description.text: Fire abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Fire abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Scorching Firebird Strike after using Fire abilities

description.name: Scorching Firebird Strike
description.text: Six single attacks (0.72 each), 100% hit rate, grants [100% Critical 1] to the user every second cast

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Ascetic Monk Mode
description.text: Fire abilities deal 10%/20%/30% more damage after casting 1/2/3+ Fire abilities, removed if the character hasn't [Awoken Blazing Monk]

description.name: Act As One Mode
description.text: Fire abilities deal 10%/30%/50% more damage after casting 1/2/3+ Fire abilities, removed if the character hasn't [Awoken Blazing Monk]
